constraints.ocl:
context Branch
inv: (self.company <> null) and (self.staffCount <> self.capacity)

context License
inv: (self.customer.license.isValid = true) and (self.number <> null)

context Branch
inv: if self.vehicleCount < self.capacity then self.vehicleCount else self.capacity endif >= 49

context Payment
inv: self.discount <= self.amount and self.amount <= self.tax

context Payment
inv: self.discount <> null and self.tax <> null

context Payment
inv: self.discount <> null implies self.amount <> null

context Reservation
inv: self.createdAt <> null and self.confirmedAt <> null

context Branch
inv: self.vehicleCount <= self.staffCount and self.staffCount <= self.capacity

context License
inv: ((self.customer <> null) and (self.customer.oclIsTypeOf(Customer))) and (not((self.customer <> null) and (self.customer.oclIsTypeOf(Customer))))

context Reservation
inv: ((self.customer <> null) and (self.dateTo.size() = 19)) and (not((self.customer <> null) and (self.dateTo.size() = 19)))

context License
inv: ((self.customer.isPremium) and (self.number.indexOf('test') >= 0)) and (not((self.customer.isPremium) and (self.number.indexOf('test') >= 0)))

context Branch
inv: ((self.monthlyRevenue < 1000) and (self.vehicles->forAll(v | v.seats <= 50))) and (self.monthlyRevenue > 1005)

context Payment
inv: (self.rental <> null) and (not(self.rental <> null))

context Payment
inv: (self.tax + self.amount > 38) and (not(self.tax + self.amount > 38))

context Customer
inv: ((self.rentalCount <= 50) and (self.rentals->forAll(v | v.lateFee <= 100))) and (not((self.rentalCount <= 50) and (self.rentals->forAll(v | v.lateFee <= 100))))

context Rental
inv: (self.lateFee - self.totalAmount >= 9) and (not(self.lateFee - self.totalAmount >= 9))

context Branch
inv: ((self.vehicleCount <> null) = (self.staffCount <> null)) and (not((self.vehicleCount <> null) = (self.staffCount <> null)))

context Vehicle
inv: ((self.tankLevel > 1) and (self.reservations->forAll(v | v.estimatedCost > 2))) and (not((self.tankLevel > 1) and (self.reservations->forAll(v | v.estimatedCost > 2))))

context Vehicle
inv: ((self.weightKg >= 0) and (self.rentals->forAll(v | v.lateFee > 5))) and (self.weightKg < 0)

context Payment
inv: (self.amount <> null implies self.tax <> null) and (not(self.amount <> null implies self.tax <> null))

context Vehicle
inv: ((self.doors <= 50) and (self.rentals->forAll(v | v.mileageEnd < 1000))) and (not((self.doors <= 50) and (self.rentals->forAll(v | v.mileageEnd < 1000))))

context Branch
inv: (self.capacity + self.vehicleCount > 53) and (not(self.capacity + self.vehicleCount > 53))

context Customer
inv: ((self.age < 10) and (self.reservations->forAll(v | v.estimatedCost <= 1000))) and (not((self.age < 10) and (self.reservations->forAll(v | v.estimatedCost <= 1000))))

context Branch
inv: (self.vehicles->any(x | x.year >= 1) <> null) and (not(self.vehicles->any(x | x.year >= 1) <> null))

context Branch
inv: (self.company <> null) and (not(self.company <> null))

context Reservation
inv: ((self.branch <> null) and (self.isConfirmed)) and (not((self.branch <> null) and (self.isConfirmed)))
